Apostle Peter Mwarabu is a Kenyan pastor and the Senior Pastor of Jesus Celebration Centre,, a growing Christian ministry in Kenya. Under his leadership, the church has expanded significantly, with multiple centers serving the community.
Early life and Calling
Details about Apostle Mwarabu's early life and calling to ministry are not widely documented. However, he has been dedicated to church leadership and spiritual mentorship for several years.
Ministry at JCC Ongata Rongai
JCC Ongata Rongai was inaugurated on 5 April 2015 with three families. It has since expanded, launching a new center along Gataka Road in 2016, which later became JCC - Light Centre. In December 2019, a third center, Jubilation Centre, was established in Nkoroi, marking the church’s growth into multiple locations. The ministry continues to focus on community outreach, discipleship, and empowering believers in their faith journey.
Apostle Mwarabu is known for his dynamic preaching, mentorship programs, and community engagement. His leadership oversees various ministries, including the Dunamis Jubilation Voices, YED Teens, Ushering & Protocol, Pastoral Ministry, Deacons, Media Ministry, Mighty Men of Valour, Women of Inspired Destiny, Royal Eaglets, and Young Eagles Dunamites.
Personal Life
Little public information is available about Apostle Mwarabu’s personal life. However, his work in ministry and leadership within the church community remains a defining aspect of his life.
